header.superHtml:
Transform handwashing into a fun and educational experience with the SuperMouth Soap-a-Hero Handwashing Station, inspired by Toothstar—home to our beloved SuperMouth superheroes. Each soap, made from naturally derived ingredients, contains one of 9 collectible SuperMouth Squad characters, encouraging children to wash their hands regularly to reveal their favorite superhero or villain. With custom slots for each character, kids will want to wash more frequently to complete their collection. This station seamlessly fits into your child’s oral care routine—reminding them to wash their hands before and after brushing and flossing their teeth. Our soaps are free from artificial chemicals, ranked #1 on EWG for safety, and designed to protect your child’s health and hygiene.


  • Collectible SuperMouth Characters: Each soap contains a fun surprise—one of our 9 SuperMouth Squad superheroes or villains, making handwashing exciting and engaging.

  • Inspired by Toothstar: The handwashing station, inspired by Toothstar’s universe, features a custom ring with slots for all 9 characters, promoting regular handwashing as kids complete their collections.

  • Safe, Naturally Derived Ingredients: Our soaps are crafted from only the safest, naturally derived ingredients, with no harsh chemicals or artificial additives. Ranked #1 by the EWG for safety, giving parents peace of mind.

  • Supports Healthy Habits: Washing hands before and after oral care routines is essential, and this station perfectly complements your child’s toothbrush, toothpaste, and floss routine.

  • Promotes Handwashing Hygiene: Encourages frequent handwashing, especially before and after oral care, fostering lifelong healthy hygiene habits.

  • Mess-Free and Long-Lasting: The soap dish is designed to keep soap dry, clean, and long-lasting, making it easy to maintain hygiene without mess.

  • Interactive and Fun Design: With its superhero-inspired design, this

    handwashing station adds a fun and engaging element to any bathroom or kitchen, helping kids build positive associations with cleanliness.


Tip: Not just for hands! The soap can also be used as a full body wash for children—and even parents. Enjoy peace of mind knowing that the entire family is using only the safest ingredients, free from artificial additives or harsh chemicals.

FAQs
items.html:
How does the Soap-a-Hero Handwashing Station encourage good hygiene habits?
The station is interactive and fun, designed to engage children and encourage regular, proper handwashing, helping build healthy habits for life.
Is the Handwashing Station easy to clean and maintain?
Yes, the Soap-a-Hero Handwashing Station is specifically designed for easy maintenance and cleaning.
Does the Soap-a-Hero Handwashing Station work with all soaps?
While it may accommodate other soaps, it’s specifically designed and ideally paired with our SuperMouth collectible scented hand soaps for optimal fun and effectiveness.
Can adults use the Soap-a-Hero Handwashing Station as well?
Yes! Although designed primarily for kids, the Soap-a-Hero Station is suitable and enjoyable for users of all ages.
